title: Unifying VXAI: A Systematic Review and Framework for the Evaluation of Explainable AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of Explainable AI (XAI) through functional metrics such as fidelity, parsimony, and robustness. While it cites ethical guidelines for 'Trustworthy AI' as a motivating context, it does not include a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, theology, or ethical/moral systems.
